problem_statement_ref: Problem Statement 26001: Collect and analyse data from satellite imagery
summary: The repository utilizes satellite-derived radar topography (Copernicus DEM GLO-30 30m/90m from TanDEM-X/SRTM) for elevation and slope features in ML susceptibility and evidence fusion. However, real optical/multispectral satellite imagery (e.g. Sentinel-2, Landsat, MODIS) is currently neither displayed on the frontend GIS map nor analyzed in the backend risk engine for land cover, vegetation vigor (NDVI), bare soil exposure, or surface change detection.

1_real_satellite_data_integrated.details: Copernicus DEM tiles (derived from TanDEM-X satellite radar mission) are stored locally in data/dem/copernicus_glo30 and queried via Open-Meteo elevation provider. True optical/multispectral/SAR satellite imagery (raster rasters, GeoTIFF imagery, or WMS/XYZ satellite image tiles) is not integrated.

active_providers.name: Copernicus DEM (GLO-30)
active_providers.source_satellite_mission: TanDEM-X / TerraSAR-X radar interferometry, augmented with SRTM
active_providers.data_type: Digital Elevation Model (elevation and derived slope)
active_providers.usage: Local GeoTIFFs (data/dem/copernicus_glo30/) and Open-Meteo elevation API

unintegrated_referenced_sources.name: NRSC Landslides Atlas of India
unintegrated_referenced_sources.status: Offline static PDF reference; no programmatic imagery extraction

unintegrated_referenced_sources.name: NASA Global Landslide Catalog
unintegrated_referenced_sources.status: Tabular event records only; no satellite imagery attached

missing_providers: ESA WorldCover / Dynamic World (satellite land cover)
Esri / Sentinel / Mapbox satellite tile basemaps

backend_analytical_evidence.details: Elevation (meters) and slope (degrees) from Copernicus DEM are consumed by the XGBoost susceptibility model and evidence fusion. However, no optical spectral bands, vegetation indices, or surface change metrics are extracted or scored.

4_current_data_feature_capability.land_cover_classification: Unavailable (requires multispectral classification or pre-classified satellite products like ESA WorldCover)
4_current_data_feature_capability.vegetation_vigor_ndvi: Unavailable (requires Red and NIR spectral bands, e.g. Sentinel-2 B4 and B8)
4_current_data_feature_capability.bare_exposed_soil: Unavailable (requires spectral index or optical segmentation)
4_current_data_feature_capability.ground_deformation_change: Unavailable (requires multi-temporal InSAR or optical change detection)

5_recommended_minimal_implementation.objective: Meaningfully satisfy 'Collect and analyse data from satellite imagery' for the hackathon without heavy compute or brittle dependencies

architecture.implementation: Add an Esri World Imagery (or Sentinel Hub) satellite basemap toggle to RiskMap.jsx (e.g. https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}) allowing instant high-resolution satellite imagery inspection of any terrain location.

architecture.component: Backend Satellite Land Cover / Vegetation Service
architecture.implementation: Implement a lightweight satellite feature provider (src/services/satelliteProviders/...) that resolves real satellite land-cover (e.g. ESA WorldCover 10m classes: Dense Forest, Shrubland, Cropland, Bare Ground, Built-up) or Sentinel-2 seasonal NDVI for queried coordinates, with local caching and offline simulation fallback.

Incorporate satellite land cover / vegetation protection factor into evidenceFusionService.js and earlyWarningService.js (e.g. bare slopes increase risk; dense forest canopy decreases risk) and display satellite provenance and imagery analysis in AreaIntelligencePanel.jsx.
